I am old now, 59 years, and I have farmed this small piece of land my whole life. My plot is small, only a little bigger than my neighbor's, and I plant maize like everyone here in Dedza. If the coupon comes from the government this year, I will use the fertilizer on my maize — last year I got one bag of NPK and one bag of urea through the subsidy, and I will hope for the same. I keep chickens and a few goats, so I carry their droppings to the field before the rains. I cannot afford to hire people; my daughter and grandchildren help me weed.
